description.en: Google Gemini API (AI Studio) over the native generateContent protocol, with account model discovery and gateway translation for OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, Responses, and Images.
description.zh: Google Gemini API（AI Studio）：声明原生 gemini（generateContent）协议，支持账号模型自动发现，并由网关提供 OpenAI Chat、Anthropic Messages、Responses 与生图互转。

description.en: Paste a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Models are discovered from your account.
description.zh: 粘贴 Google AI Studio 的 Gemini API Key；模型将从你的账号自动发现。
